title: TriageResult
description: Structured result of the AI triage of a production error. The workflow turns it into an issue comment; it never sets labels from it except ai-triaged.

severity.description: P1: prd unusable for most users. P2: a main feature broken in prd, or many users hit it. P3: limited impact or a workaround, or only in dev/stg. P4: cosmetic or noise.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences: what breaks for users, where and since when.

cause.description: The most likely root cause, with how confident you are. Say so when the evidence is not enough.

location.description: The app file and line where it goes wrong (e.g. src/components/Leaderboard.tsx:12), or an empty string if unknown.

reason.description: Why this commit may have caused it.

duplicate_of.description: Number of an existing issue from related-issues.json with the same root cause, or 0.

recommendation.description: ai-fixable only when every ai-fixable criterion in triage.md holds.

recommendation_reason.description: One sentence: which criteria hold or fail.

repro.description: How a unit test could reproduce it: component or function, input, expected vs actual. Empty if you cannot tell.
